Name: DC Burger Krobus for CP Updated for 1.5
Author: ignoremeimaidiot
Description:
This is an updated version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4608]DC Burger Krobus for CP[/url] created by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/4645963]somohexual[/url], which is inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4745]DCBurger's Portrait Mod[/url] created by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/66555116]Tryptan (aka DCBurger)[/url] and is based on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3685]New Krobus to match DC Burger's Portraits[/url] created by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/53971052]Kitchenarm[/url]. Finally updated to include the Movie Theater Outfit!

I heavily referenced [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3842?tab=description]Void Creature Krobus[/url] created by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/67941676]neocores[/url] for the extra sprites and their .json files so this could even be put in Content Patcher in the first place so please go support them it's such a lovely mod it even has a portrait to match it. 

Bugs (POSSIBLE SPOILERS):

- 14 Heart Event won't show correct sprite, no idea where to find that sprite sheet so if anyone has any ideas where to find it I'm all ears.
